Abbate appointed President and Chief Executive Officer Third quarter results reflect significant underperformance in Europe Alvarez Marsal retained to advise Company on European operations Withdraws full-year 2026 guidance ANTIOCH, Tenn., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - LKQ Corporation (Nasdaq: LKQ) today announced preliminary, unaudited results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, as well as leadership and operational actions intended to address recent performance and position the Company for improved execution under new leadership. Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Results Based on preliminary unaudited financials for the third quarter, LKQ expects to report the following: Revenue of $3.32 billion, compared with $3.50 billion in the third quarter of 2025 Parts and services organic revenue decline of 5.4% Net loss 1 of $16 million to $32 million, including $111 million of non-cash impairment charges, compared with net income 1 of $178 million
articles.title: LKQ Corporation Announces Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Results and Leadership and Operational Actions

articles.summary: ANTIOCH, Tenn., Oct. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - LKQ Corporation (Nasdaq: LKQ) today reported third quarter 2026 financial results. Commenting on the third quarter, John Mendel, Chairman of the Board of LKQ, said: “LKQ remains a fundamentally strong enterprise, supported by its scale, leading positions across key markets, and global distribution platform. At the same time, our recent financial and operating performance has not reflected the strength of the business or met the standards we expect, particularly in Europe. The Board has been deeply engaged in addressing these challenges, and the appointment of a new CEO, leadership changes in Europe, and the engagement of Alvarez Marsal are important steps in a broader effort to improve execution and financial performance. articles.title: LKQ Corporation Announces Results For Third Quarter 2026

articles.summary: Proven distribution leader to sharpen execution, drive improved performance and create long-term shareholder value ANTIOCH, Tenn., Oct. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - LKQ Corporation (Nasdaq: LKQ) today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Salvatore A. “Sal” Abbate as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective December 15, 2026. He succeeds Justin Jude, who is departing the Company effective today. Until Mr. Abbate assumes the role of President and Chief Executive Officer, the Company has established an interim Office of the Chief Executive Officer to provide ongoing leadership continuity, consisting of John Mendel, Chairman of the Board, and Sue Gove, Chair of LKQ’s Audit Committee. The Office of the Chief Executive Officer will work closely with LKQ’s leadership teams and management in overseeing the Company’s operations during the interim period. Mr. Abbate brings more than three decades of experience leading large, complex distribution and industrial businesses.
articles.title: LKQ Corporation Appoints Salvatore A. Abbate as President and Chief Executive Officer
